Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on site-specific N- and O-glycosylation of ErbB2 and EGFR. Enrichment was achieved via graphitized carbon tip columns to capture hydrophilic glycopeptides. Quantification is label-free based on precursor intensities.

scope: sErbB2 and sEGFR were purified from the collected media by the liquid chromatography AKTA GO system (Cytiva) with HisTrap HP for affinity chromatogram, MonoQ 5/50 GL for anion exchange chromatogram, and HiLoad 16/600 Superdex200pg for gel filtration.
ErbB2 was immunoprecipitated by mixing pre-cleared cell lysates with antibody-conjugated beads followed by incubation at 4°C for 4 h.

Purified sErbB2, sEGFR and the immunoprecipitated ErbB2 from cancer cells were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical) for 40 min at 56°C, followed by alkylation with 20 mM iodoacetamide (FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical) for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
